email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Web Platform Specialist role at Recurv. With a technical background in web development and digital marketing, I am excited by the opportunity to contribute to the evolution of a global public web platform.

In my recent work, I have built and optimized websites using WordPress and custom code, implemented structured data and llms.txt, and collaborated with developers on platform improvements. I have experience writing test scripts, validating features, and coordinating releases. My proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Python, combined with my SEO and analytics skills, allows me to bridge technical and business needs effectively.

The chance to work on a transition from Drupal/PHP to a React-based environment aligns with my continuous learning mindset. I am eager to bring my proactive and structured approach to your team in Antwerp.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Web Platform Specialist position at Recurv, as advertised. With a solid foundation in web development and digital marketing, I am drawn to the opportunity to shape the technical evolution of a global public web platform.

My experience includes building and optimizing websites on WordPress, where I managed site structure, content, and integrations. I have implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and llms.txt to enhance search visibility, and I regularly write Python scripts to automate tasks such as scraping and reporting. This technical hands-on work has given me a deep understanding of CMS and front-end architecture, as well as the ability to communicate effectively with developers and stakeholders.

In my role at Knowledge Experts, I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for major clients, which involved coordinating with technical teams and ensuring smooth deployments. I also ran SEO analyses and reported on performance, which required a structured approach to prioritization and quality assurance. I have experience writing test scripts and validating solutions, and I am keen to further develop my skills in test automation.

The prospect of contributing to a major transition from Drupal/PHP to a React-based environment is particularly exciting. I am a proactive learner, eager to take ownership of the platform's technical direction while collaborating closely with the Product Owner and external partners. My ability to translate complex technical topics into practical guidance, combined with my strong self-organization, makes me a good fit for this role.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and open to hybrid working in Antwerp. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Technical experience with web platforms: built and optimized multi-page websites in WordPress, implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and llms.txt for improved search visibility.
- Ability to write and understand code: proficient in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Python; developed front-end features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS.
- Experience with website testing: ran SEO analyses, reported on performance, and validated solutions; familiar with writing test scripts and supporting quality assurance.
- Strong self-organization and ownership: managed website projects from structure to content, coordinated with developers and stakeholders, and delivered measurable results.
- Proactive and collaborative mindset: daily use of AI tools and automation to streamline workflows, with a focus on clear communication of technical topics to non-technical audiences.
